longTitle.officialTitle: To clarify certain provisions of the Native American Veterans’ Memorial Establishment Act of 1994.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Native American Veterans’ Memorial Amendments Act of 2013”.

subsection.heading: Authority To Establish Memorial.—
subsection.chapeau: Section 3 of the Native American Veterans’ Memorial Establishment Act of 1994 (20 U.S.C. 80q-5 note; 108 Stat. 4067) is amended—

paragraph.content: in subsection (b), by striking “within the interior structure of the facility provided for by” and inserting “on property under the jurisdiction of the Museum on the site described in”; and
in subsection (c)(1), by striking “, in consultation with the Museum, is” and inserting “and the National Museum of the American Indian are”.

subsection.heading: Payment of Expenses.—
subsection.chapeau: Section 4(a) of the Native American Veterans’ Memorial Establishment Act of 1994 (20 U.S.C. 80q-5 note; 108 Stat. 4067) is amended—

paragraph.content: in the heading, by inserting “and National Museum of the American Indian” after “American Indians”; and
in the first sentence, by striking “shall be solely” and inserting “and the National Museum of the American Indian shall be”.
